subject.title: fix(gateway): deliver OAuth authorization URLs to non-terminal clients

question: Should OpenClaw accept `WizardPrompter.presentsAuthChallenge` as the provider-auth contract and treat those clients as remote/manual for OAuth URL delivery?
rationale: The code fix is plausible, but it changes a plugin-facing auth prompt contract and provider routing behavior, so maintainer intent is required before merge even if CI stays green.

options.title: Accept After Proof And Rebase
options.body: Require inspectable companion proof, resolve the merge conflict, and then accept the new auth-presenting prompter contract for provider OAuth flows.

options.title: Narrow The Contract
options.body: Ask the author to avoid or reduce the plugin-facing capability if maintainers want the fix limited to the shared OAuth helper behavior.

options.title: Pause Behind #94661
options.body: Keep this PR paused while the broader wizard RPC parity issue settles a single contract for auth, progress, and pairing surfaces.

recommendation.title: Accept After Proof And Rebase
recommendation.body: Require inspectable companion proof, resolve the merge conflict, and then accept the new auth-presenting prompter contract for provider OAuth flows.

likelyOwner.reason: The central changed seam is provider OAuth/auth-choice architecture, where the strongest history signal points to steipete-authored refactors.
